skill.summary: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. 7500+ GitHub stars. Search and read 14 platforms: Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongS...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of agent-reach 1.0.0:

- Enables agent search, reading, posting, and interaction across 14 platforms (e.g., Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu, Douyin, Weibo, WeChat Articles, LinkedIn, Instagram, RSS, SkillBoss API, and general web pages)
- One-command install; zero configuration needed for 8 channels; diagnostics via agent-reach doctor
- Broad trigger phrase support for natural language and platform-specific actions in Chinese and English
- Unified API and command-line instructions for searching, scraping, and posting to platforms
- Troubleshooting and persistent data handling explained in detailed usage guide
